moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio sh-march, written here): Dashed stroke, dash 10 / gap 8 px; lineDashOffset decreases linearly by one dash period (18 px) every 1000 ms (recipe; the demo runs 36 px / s), looping seamlessly. Demo on a rounded rect 180 x 100 (r 12, 3 px stroke) and a baseline. Params: dash (10 px) · gap (8 px) · speed (1 chu kỳ / 1 s).
